import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

spending_cols = [
    'MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts',
    'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds'
]

avg_spending = df[spending_cols].mean().sort_values()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=avg_spending.values, y=avg_spending.index, palette='viridis', orient='h')
plt.title('Average Customer Spending by Product Category')
plt.xlabel('Average Spending (€)')
plt.ylabel('Product Category')
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
